title: Maximum induced emf
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the maximum induced electromotive force using the given expression or Faraday's law.

title: Effective current calculation
description: Important: Correctly determines the effective current from the maximum current in the sinusoidal AC circuit.

title: Bulb power consumption
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the electric power consumed by the bulb using the effective current and its resistance.

title: Average emf for charge
description: Important: Applies Faraday's law to find the average induced emf over the specified time interval for the non-sinusoidal change.

title: Charge via average current
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the charge passing through the bulb by integrating the average current over time or using the flux change.

title: Circuit resistance sum
description: Important: Uses the total circuit resistance (bulb plus coil) in Ohm's law calculations for current.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout the calculations and presents final answers with correct units.

title: Confusing peak with effective
description: Pitfall: Uses peak current instead of effective value when calculating the bulb's power.

title: Incorrect flux change interval
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the change in magnetic field (ΔB) or the time interval (Δt) for the charge calculation in part (3).
